title: Theoretical Prediction on the Synthesis Reaction Pathway of N6 (C2h)
authors: Wang L.J., Warburton P., Mezey P.G.
notes_general: Paper is about a synthesis PATHWAY from HN3 + N3F -> N6 + HF. Reactants/TS/complexes all contain H and/or F (out of scope). Only the final product N6 (C2h, open-chain diazide/hexaazadiazide) is pure-N and in scope -- this is the SAME topology as the existing corpus entry 'N6_C2h_chain'. Figure 1 (last panel, labeled 'N6') shows an atom-labeled 2D diagram with 3 levels of theory per bond (HF/6-31G**, B3LYP/6-31G**, B3LYP/6-311++G**) -- read with moderate confidence given label density; treat bond values below as approximate, not authoritative to 4 sig figs.

bond_params.confidence: moderate -- read from a dense multi-value labeled figure without atom coordinates, not a printed table

species.notes: Relative energy of N6+HF product = -27.7 kcal/mol (B3LYP/6-311++G**) / -40.3 (CCSD). This is the target product of a proposed synthesis route (HN3 + N3F -> N6 + HF), barrier 21.4-27.0 kcal/mol depending on method -- context for future HEDM synthesis-feasibility discussion, not a new topology.
